research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Intersect ENT is researching self-expanding devices and methods for delivering implants to the body, as described in Self-expanding devices and methods therefor. They are also developing systems, devices, and methods for treating sinus conditions using implants with hubs and expandable legs, as detailed in Systems, devices, and method for treating a sinus condition. Additionally, they focus on drug-coated expandable devices for treating nose, ear, or throat diseases, and devices for paranasal sinus conditions.

overview_description.description: Intersect ENT Inc. (formerly Sinexus) is a medical device company pioneering novel therapies for Ear, Nose, and Throat surgeons to utilize in providing improved treatment for their patients. The company was founded in 2003 by Don Eaton and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: Intersect ENT provides therapy solutions that enable ENT physicians to improve patients' quality of life.

product.name: PROPEL Sinus Implant
product.description: A steroid-releasing implant designed to maintain sinus patency and reduce inflammation after sinus surgery.

product.name: PROPEL Mini Sinus Implant
product.description: A smaller version of the PROPEL implant for steroid delivery to smaller sinus cavities post-surgery.

product.name: PROPEL Mini with SDS
product.description: A PROPEL Mini implant combined with a steroid delivery system for localized postoperative inflammation control.

product.name: PROPEL Contour Sinus Implant
product.description: A sinus implant designed to conform to sinus anatomy for localized steroid delivery after surgery.

product.name: SINUVA Sinus Implant
product.description: A steroid-releasing implant for in-office treatment of recurrent nasal polyps in patients with chronic rhinosinusitis.
